# UniversalComputationCriticality

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The property of a network at criticality to perform any computation that a Turing machine can, leveraging the system's sensitivity to perturbations and long-range correlations. For TCC, this provides a theoretical basis for building topology-centric computing systems that are inherently computationally universal without explicit programming.
